      "linked_component_id": "COMP-01",
      "category": "Design Specification",
      "description": "Offshore wind turbine foundations should avoid the use of pile driving where feasible, in order to minimize noise impacts on North Atlantic right whales.",
      "source_section_number": "4.3",
      "geographic_scope": "Offshore wind lease areas",
      "context_quote": "The agencies are committed to working with lessees to develop standards for determining where it would be preferred to use foundation designs that do not rely on pile driving (e.g., gravity-based foundations), as well as to not detonate UXOs when other means of removal are possible."
    },

      "constraint_id": "C-002",
      "linked_component_id": "COMP-01",
      "category": "Environmental Mitigation",
      "description": "If pile driving cannot be avoided, noise abatement systems (e.g., double big bubble curtains) must be used to reduce noise levels to the maximum extent practicable.",
      "source_section_number": "4.3",
      "geographic_scope": "Offshore wind lease areas",
      "context_quote": "Where pile driving and UXO detonations cannot be avoided, lessees should use the most effective methodologies available to reduce noise to the maximum extent practicable, including, but not limited to, use of noise abatement systems (e.g., double big bubble curtains)."
    },
    {
      "constraint_id": "C-003",
      "linked_component_id": "COMP-01",
      "category": "Environmental Mitigation",
      "description": "Pile driving activities must be scheduled to avoid times of year when North Atlantic right whales are most likely to be present in the lease areas and along vessel transit routes.",

      "geographic_scope": "Offshore wind lease areas and vessel transit routes",
      "context_quote": "Project schedules should avoid installing foundations during the time of year when NARWs are most likely to occur in the lease areas and along vessel routes, including known areas of higher NARW density and persistence, and including, but not limited to, Nantucket Shoals, Cape Cod Bay, calving grounds, and designated NARW critical habitat."
    },
    {
      "constraint_id": "C-004",
      "linked_component_id": "COMP-05",
      "category": "Environmental Mitigation",
      "description": "Project vessels must not exceed a speed of 10 knots when operating in areas where North Atlantic right whales may be present.",
      "value": 10,
      "unit": "knots",
      "source_section_number": "4.3",
      "geographic_scope": "Areas where North Atlantic right whales may be present",
      "context_quote": "All vessels underway must slow to 10 knots or less at any time/location that NARWs may be present and at any time when visibility is poor."
    },
    {
      "constraint_id": "C-005",
      "linked_component_id": "COMP-03",
      "category": "Environmental Mitigation",
      "description": "Cable trenching activities are prohibited within 500 meters of identified historic shipwrecks.",
      "value": 500,
      "unit": "meters",
      "source_section_number": "4.3",
      "geographic_scope": "Areas within 500 meters of identified historic shipwrecks",
      "context_quote": "Furthermore, trenching activities are prohibited within 500 meters of the identified historic shipwreck (No. 551B) at all times."

      "category": "Environmental Mitigation",
      "description": "Noise levels from pile driving activities must not exceed the NOAA Fisheries Level A permanent threshold shift limits for low-frequency cetaceans (such as North Atlantic right whales) at distances greater than 1,000 meters from each foundation.",
      "value": 1000,
      "unit": "meters",
      "source_section_number": "4.3",
      "geographic_scope": "Areas within 1,000 meters of each wind turbine foundation",
      "context_quote": "Sound fields generated during impact pile driving should be reduced to the maximum extent practicable with a goal of not exceeding NOAA Fisheries' Level A permanent threshold shift (PTS) limits for low frequency cetaceans (LFC) at distances greater than 1,000 meters from each foundation."
    },
    {
      "constraint_id": "C-007",
      "linked_component_id": "COMP-05",
      "category": "Environmental Mitigation",
      "description": "Project vessels must maintain a vigilant watch for North Atlantic right whales and take appropriate action to avoid striking them, regardless of vessel size.",
      "source_section_number": "4.3",
      "geographic_scope": "All project vessel transit routes",
      "context_quote": "Vessel captains, trained crew members, and PSOs should maintain a vigilant watch for all protected species and slow down, stop their vessel, or alter course, as appropriate and regardless of vessel size, to avoid striking any protected species."
    },
    {
      "constraint_id": "C-008",
      "linked_component_id": "COMP-01",
      "category": "Environmental Mitigation",
      "description": "Clearance zones must be established around pile driving activities, within which work must be delayed if a North Atlantic right whale is detected.",
      "source_section_number": "4.3",
      "geographic_scope": "Areas around pile driving activities",
      "context_quote": "Clearance zones are an area around a pile (or detonation location), monitored by PSOs, wherein a detection (visual or acoustic) of a NARW triggers a delay of the start of the activity."
    },
    {
      "constraint_id": "C-009",
      "linked_component_id": "COMP-01",
      "category": "Environmental Mitigation",
      "description": "Shutdown zones must be established around pile driving activities, within which work must be stopped if a North Atlantic right whale is detected.",
      "source_section_number": "4.3",
      "geographic_scope": "Areas around pile driving activities",
      "context_quote": "Shutdown zones are an area around a pile (or other activity) that is monitored by PSOs, wherein a detection (visual or acoustic) of a NARW triggers a stop of the activity."

      "source_section_number": "4.3",
      "geographic_scope": "Areas around noise-generating activities",
      "context_quote": "Sound field verification (SFV) will need to be conducted for activities the agencies deem necessary, including but not limited to pile driving, UXO detonation, and operations."

      "linked_component_id": "COMP-01",

      "description": "Unexploded ordnance (UXO) must be addressed using the least impactful methods, prioritizing avoidance through micrositing and low-order incineration over high-order detonation.",
      "source_section_number": "4.3",
      "geographic_scope": "Offshore wind lease areas",
      "context_quote": "The agencies are committed to working with Federal partners and lessees to develop and implement standard protocols for addressing unexploded ordinances, including implementation of best available technology to avoid or minimize exposure of NARWs and their sensitive habitats to in-situ disposal (low order incineration or high order detonation). If disposal is necessary, after demonstrating that avoidance through micrositing is not feasible, low order incineration is preferred over high order detonations."

      "category": "Environmental Mitigation",
      "description": "Routine clean-ups of abandoned, lost, or discarded fishing gear and other debris associated with offshore wind development must be implemented within lease areas.",
